answer: Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, converted to a slow vesting stream, no identity may audit its own recruit. The plume lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the fable is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the lotus of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
